value.rationale: Coefficientwise optimization across all fixed-order, fixed-chromatic-class complete multipartite profiles is a natural exact graph-polynomial extremal theorem, not a renamed polynomial formula. The unique smallest failure of log-concavity in the family is a motivated complete finite cutoff and has an infinite algebraically proved continuation. The result distinguishes log-concavity from the published unimodality phenomenon.
